PM Modi highlights local achievements in 'Mann Ki Baat' and Vibrant Village program

Prime Minister Narendra Modi, during his 'Mann Ki Baat' radio address, praised various local initiatives and individuals across India. He highlighted a waste-to-wealth model from Sitamarhi, a water conservation model from Sidhi, and herbal tea production by women in Bijnor. Modi also commended the Indian women's cricket team and athlete PV Sindhu. Separately, in the Viksit Vibrant Village program, he interacted with youth from border villages, emphasizing their role as the nation's first villages.
